; PROBE (temporary): does the inSuspend chrome-less app repaint reach the framebuffer
; at a BUTTON (0->2) entry before the sleep window surface covers it?
; On every 0->2, fires rm-shot salvo at 150/300/500ms to /tmp/probe_d*.png
; (the mod's own delay-0 shot to current.png is the baseline). One salvo per entry,
; re-armed on wake. Inspect which delays are chrome-less vs already-sleep-window.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: delayShotProbe
				visible: false

				property bool armed: true

				XoviMessageBroker { id: delayShotBroker }

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						if (previous === 0 && next === 2 && delayShotProbe.armed) {
							delayShotProbe.armed = false;
							delayShotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot", "/tmp/probe_d150.png,150");
							delayShotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot", "/tmp/probe_d300.png,300");
							delayShotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot", "/tmp/probe_d500.png,500");
							console.log("DELAYSHOT salvo fired t=" + Date.now());
						}
						if (next === 0) delayShotProbe.armed = true;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
